RISE Staking & Liquidity Update
,
First, apologies for the late communication. We decided to make a few changes that improve the staking and LP structure, and ran out of time to properly communicate this to you. These improvements are designed to increase stability, improve user experience, and expand our reach to new liquidity providers. This will be updated in our documentation.
Below is a full breakdown of what’s changing, what’s new, and how rewards will work going forward.

@everyone



Withdrawal Lock Removed
,


We are removing the 13-week withdrawal period for hosted staking on our EVM staking site.
This applies to:
Base RISE token staking
Aerodrome v2 LP staking
You will now be able to withdraw with no time penalty, giving you more flexibility and control.



Two Aerodrome Pools Instead of One
,


We are splitting liquidity across two Aerodrome pools:
Aerodrome v2 (Constant Product Pool — ~80% of team Base liquidity)
This will be the primary pool
Staking is hosted on https://evm-staking.infinityrising.com/
This is the simplest, most passive method of LP staking
Ideal for users who want “deposit LP and earn”
Aerodrome v3 Slipstream (Concentrated Liquidity — ~20% of team Base liquidity)
Rewards will be hosted through Merkl - https://app.merkl.xyz/
No staking required — Merkl scans your wallet for your v3 NFT
Best for LPs who want more control or hold more ETH
Campaign ID to be provided soon



Merkl Integration (150k Monthly Users)
,


Merkl is widely used across DeFi and recommended by Aerodrome for Slipstream until we qualify for a full whitelist.
Benefits:
No staking required — just hold your v3 NFT
Merkl automatically detects your position
Rewards are allocated transparently and fairly
Helps bring new LPs from their 150k+ monthly users
Attracts pro and active liquidity managers into the RISE ecosystem
Learn more about Merkl:
 https://docs.merkl.xyz/earn-with-merkl/earning-with-merkl
 
Reward strategy examples:
 https://docs.merkl.xyz/merkl-mechanisms/campaign-types/concentrated-liquidity-mechanisms#reward-strategy-examples



Reward Distribution — How the 38,250 Daily Base RISE is Allocated
,


RISE LP rewards on Base are fixed at 38,250 RISE per day.
This is divided between:
Aerodrome v2 (hosted on our site) - 60% of rewards (22,950 per day)
Aerodrome v3 Slipstream (via Merkl) - 40% of rewards (15,300 per day)

This is a new campaign and will be reviewed after the 90 day period for effectiveness.



Reward Distribution — How the 38,250 Daily Cardano RISE is Allocated
,


Minswap LP Farm - Reward Allocation
34,250 RISE per day (out of the 38,250) is allocating to the Minswap LP Farm
VyFi Partnership — Reward Allocation
As part of our long-standing partnership and the support VyFi provided during migration:
4,000 RISE per day (out of the 38,250) will be allocated to the VyFi LP farm they are launching.

Primary Pool Locations (Where the Liquidity Lives)
Our core liquidity continues to be:
Minswap (Cardano)
Aerodrome (Base)

RISE/WETH Liquidity Rewards Start Tomorrow on Merkl
,
Liquidity incentives for the RISE/WETH v3 pool officially live starting November 18th at 15:00 UTC through Merkl.

https://app.merkl.xyz/opportunities/base/AERODROME_GAUGE_CAP/0xdb79699053a9f0a7f91584af7d2e5f33647e04f7

This is the first step in building deeper, more efficient liquidity on Base, and it’s open to everyone.

What’s a Concentrated Liquidity Pool?

One of our Aerodrome pool’s uses concentrated liquidity (Slipstream/v3):

-Contract:  0xdb79699053a9f0a7f91584af7d2e5f33647e04f7

-Instead of spreading liquidity across every possible price, you choose a price range where your liquidity is active.

-When you deposit the token pair of the pool, you receive an ERC-721 token (NFT). To earn rewards, you simply manage your position directly from your wallet to keep your liquidity active. Active simply means that the trading price of RISE falls between the low price and high price you set when you deposit liquidity.

-No staking required. Merkl calculates rewards based on the wallets holding liquidity in the pool. User’s must connect their wallet to the platform to claim their rewards.

If you want to maximize rewards, keeping your position in-range is key.

How Rewards Are Split (15,300 RISE/day less small platform fee)

The Merkl campaign distributes rewards according to the following structure:

60% — Based on your WETH liquidity
Builds deeper WETH liquidity, improving price stability for larger trades
,
WETH-heavy positions earn more of this share.
,

30% — Based on swap fees
Liquidity closer to the active price captures more trading volume.
,
More volume → more rewards.
,

10% — Based on your RISE liquidity
Supports deeper RISE books and reduces slippage for buyers.
,

Your actual rewards depend on staying in-range, your range width, and how much your liquidity contributes to real trades.

Why Merkl?

Aerodrome’s gauge system requires certain volume and liquidity levels before a project can receive official emissions.

We’re not at those thresholds yet, but using Merkl lets us:

-Start incentives immediately
-Reward LPs fairly and transparently
-Build liquidity early
-Prepare for a future Aerodrome gauge listing once volume grows
-More can be found in Aerodrome’s partner FAQ doc here
https://docs.google.com/document/u/1/d/e/2PACX-1vTIfsVDmcpsBJDbS3QQwU_CuX6WW-qRXeOQ8cB4TnRgPvh4zYWxx2I6zf7XXYqFbuL8XL5jfmJIY7jY/pub
